title: A Theoretical Analysis of Environment-Aware Out-of-Distribution Detection for Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.27211v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual vision-language models (VLMs) encounter a stream of environments and must also reject inputs that do not belong to the environment at hand.   Class information from earlier environments can aid out-of-distribution (OOD) detection, yet existing detectors score each environment in isolation, and when previous environments help or hurt is theoretically unclear. We develop a theory of environment-aware OOD detection built on contribution scores, pairwise cosine expectations measuring how the image and text features of one environment align with those of another. We propose a cross-environment maximum-concept-matching (MCM) score with two terms: a primary term matching the test image against the current class texts, and a secondary term matching it against the class texts of a previous environment, weighted by the intra-modal alignment between the two environments. translated_abstract: 持续学习的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）会面对一连串的环境流，同时还必须拒绝那些不属于当前环境的输入。来自先前环境的类别信息可以辅助分布外（OOD）检测，然而现有的检测器对每个环境进行孤立评分，且先前环境在何时有益或有害在理论上尚不明确。我们基于贡献分数（contribution scores）构建了环境感知OOD检测的理论体系，贡献分数是一种成对余弦期望，用于衡量一个环境的图像和文本特征与另一个环境的对齐程度。我们提出了一种跨环境最大概念匹配（MCM）分数，它包含两项：主项将测试图像与当前环境的类别文本进行匹配，次项将测试图像与先前环境的类别文本进行匹配，并以两个环境之间的模内对齐度作为权重。我们证明，在正向环境转移和有界……（摘要截断）的条件下，
tldr: 该论文基于衡量环境间图像与文本特征对齐程度的“贡献分数”建立了环境感知OOD检测理论，提出了由当前环境主项和先前环境次项（按环境间模内对齐度加权）构成的跨环境最大概念匹配（MCM）评分方法，并从理论上阐明了先前环境何时有益或有害于OOD检测。
